changes.title: Chart close zoom
items: Zoom right in on an island on the sea chart: it fills the screen, its hills shaded, each area's ground in its own colour, the sea pale in the shallows round its coast

changes.title: Runestone variants
items: Every area's runestone is a little different now: 20 weathered shapes, some mirrored, with the carving always the right way round

changes.title: Bots home guard
items: The bot game's witch leaves a few fighters on guard at home when she passes by with plenty following her
